 Order

This is second bail application filed under Section 439 of the Cr.P.C. on behalf of applicant (483 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023).
2.

The applicant is in jail since 23.09.2024 in connection with Crime No.269 of 2024 registered at P.S. Sohagpur, District-Narmadapuram for the offence punishable under Sections 363, 368, 366A,
376, 376(D), 34, 109, 201, 506 of IPC and Sections 3, 4, 16, 17 of POCSO Act and Sections 3(1)(w)(i),
3(2)
(v) & 3(2)(va) of SC/ST Act.
3. Prosecution story in brief is that applicant repeatedly committed aggravated penetrative sexual assault on minor prosecutrix.

4. Learned counsel for the applicant submits that on 10.12.2024, earlier applicant's bail application was dismissed as withdrawn with liberty to repeat the same after the statement of victim is recorded.
As of now, prosecutrix has been examined.

Further, after referring to statement of prosecutrix, it is urged that in the cross examination of prosecutrix, she did not support the prosecution story and has denied the incident and has refused to recognize applicant.

sentences.text: On above grounds, it is urged that applicant be released on bail.
5. Learned counsel for the respondent/State, on the other hand, has opposed the application.
6. Looking to overall facts and circumstances of the case, I deem it proper to release the applicant on bail.

7. It is directed that applicant be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.15,000/- (Rupees Fifteen Thousand only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court, for his regular appearance before the trial Court during trial with a condition that he shall remain present before the concerned Court on all the dates fixed by it during trial.
He shall abide by all the conditions enumerated under Section 480(3) of Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023.
8. This order shall be effective till the end of the trial.
However, in case of bail jump and breach of any of the conditions of bail, it shall become ineffective.
9. Soft copy of this bail order be sent immediately/forthwith to the applicant through concerned Jail Superintendent.
10. M.Cr.C. stands allowed and disposed of.
11. Certified copy as per rules.

(ACHAL KUMAR PALIWAL) JUDGE sm Shankar Patel vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 4 September, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/15312729/
